title: The exterior sheafification unit is bijective on affine quasi-coherent sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], $U$ an affine open of $X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $n\geq0$. Let $P_n(W)=\bigwedge^n_{\mathcal O_X(W)}F(W)$, with its canonical restrictions and sheafification $E_n$ [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. The canonical sheafification-unit map $P_n(U)\to E_n(U)$ is bijective. There is no finite-presentation or local-freeness assumption.

source.place: Lemma 26.7.2(2), lemma-widetilde-tensor; with Tag 01IA, lemma-quasi-coherent-affine, and Tag 01HV, lemma-spec-sheaves.

proof.text: For every affine W and section a of its structure ring, use isLocalizedModule_basicOpen to identify the restriction of M to D(a) as localization at powers of a. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_basicOpen provides the compatible localization of rings.

Apply exteriorPower.isLocalizedModule_of_wedge to this module localization. PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti supplies the pure-wedge map-compatibility hypothesis. Thus all principal restrictions of the canonical exterior presheaf are localizations. The old exteriorSheafPresheaf is equal to this presheaf: its objects are definitionally equal, and its restrictions agree by exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique. The consumers prove this equality privately before transporting the upstream unit theorem.

Apply isIso_sheafificationUnit_app_of_affine_localizing to the exterior presheaf and evaluate at U. A module isomorphism is bijective by ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso. This works uniformly for degree zero and the empty affine open.

proof_origin.note: Retirement of the duplicate Sheaf module. The upstream proof preserves the principal-localization route, and each consumer transports it through the proved equality of exterior presheaves.

theorem exteriorSheaf_affine_unit_bijective {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) (U : X.affineOpens) :
